jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Signaturit Group is a company that is revolutionizing the way people do business through secure digital transactions. With over 250000 customers in more than 40 countries, we provide electronic signature and digital identification solutions that allow users to sign over 78 million documents digitally.
As a trusted third party, we are eIDAS certified and follow (to the letter!) European standards and the ANSSI General Security Regulation to offer all legal guarantees in terms of securing our customers' online transactions.

We have offices in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, and Paris working together to help companies of any size and sector to optimize their administrative tasks related to document signing and digital communication.

Join the team that is building the European leader in trusted digital transactions! For more information, visit www.signaturit.com and follow us on Twitter.

Context:

We are currently seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our Tech... team at Signaturit.

In this pivotal role, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of our Infrastructure as Code (IaC) initiatives, primarily utilizing Terraform to streamline and enhance our Cloud infrastructure.

What experience and skills do I need?
• Experience working in Linux environments and Amazon Web Services (EC2, ECS, Route 53, Cloudfront, RDS, S3, Redis, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, Lambda).
• Experience working with Terraform to maintain infrastructures deployed in Amazon Web Services.
• Experience working in CI/CD pipelines with GitLab or Jenkins.
• Experience with Orchestration (Puppet, Chef, Ansible, etc), Automation.
• Experience in managing revision control system with GIT.
• Good analytical skills.
• Working proficiency in English.

YOUR MISSION
What will you do at Signaturit Group?

Infrastructure as Code: Define and maintain robust and scalable infrastructure using Terraform, ensuring a reliable and efficient deployment environment.

CI/CD Pipelines: Develop, automate, and maintain continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines using GitLab and Jenkins, enhancing the efficiency and reliability of our software delivery process.

AWS Infrastructure Management: Take charge of our AWS infrastructure, continuously maintaining, evolving, and optimizing to meet our growing needs.

Environment Oversight: Manage all production and QA environments, ensuring high availability and performance.

Monitoring and Alerting: Utilize the ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana) for service monitoring, along with CloudWatch, Advisor, Node exporter, Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog for comprehensive infrastructure monitoring.

Collaborative Solution Designing: Assist development teams in designing auto-scalable, fault tolerant, and highly available services, contributing to the resilience and efficiency of our applications.

Migration Projects: Participate in workload migrations from on-premise servers to AWS, leveraging your expertise in cloud computing.

Continuous Improvement: Be an active participant in continuously improving our workflows, processes, and organizational structure, ensuring we remain agile and innovative.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at SignaturIt, your role will be crucial in shaping the future of our technology stack and processes. You'll be part of a team that values expertise, creativity, and collaborative problem-solving.
WHY US?
Which benefits do we offer to our team?
• Flexible remote work.
• Working hour flexibility (Mon-Tues 08:00-10:00 / 17:00-19:00, Frid 08:00-10:00 / 15:00-17:00).
• Intensive working day on Fridays, July and August.
• Catering service at the office.
• Health insurance with family discount.
• Technical training with specialized platforms.
• English classes with native teachers.
• Birthday off.
• Referral bonus.
• Flexible compensation plan with Cobee
• Snacks and fruit at the office.

ABOUT US
Signaturit Group is a company that is revolutionizing the way people do business through secure digital transactions. With over 250000 customers in more than 40 countries, we provide electronic signature and digital identification solutions that allow users to sign over 78 million documents digitally.

As a trusted third party, we are eIDAS certified and follow (to the letter!) European standards and the ANSSI General Security Regulation to offer all legal guarantees in terms of securing our customers' online transactions.

We have offices in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, and Paris working together to help companies of any size and sector to optimize their administrative tasks related to document signing and digital communication

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer - DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Requisition Number : 183823Can this position be remote? : Yes

We are a global team of creators, storytellers, technologists, experience originators, innovators and so much more. We believe amazing games and experiences start with teams as diverse as the players and communities we serve.

At Electronic Arts, the only limit is your imagination.

Remote Options within Spain.

We span four continents, bringing together diverse individuals passionate about their craft from across the globe. We partner in every development phase while improving our expertise to create even greater experiences for players.

C&D participates in creating some of the most beloved games and supporting our ongoing live services. Through cutting-edge technology, data-driven insights, and state-of-the-art practices, we drive quality and directly impact players.

We are a learning organization, sharing collaboratively and exploring innovative ways to solve challenges in creating amazing games for millions of... players worldwide.

POSITION OVERVIEW :

The Development Release Engineer is part of a centralized team (DRE). We manage DevOps across EA. You will provide important end-to-end Continuous Integration / Deployment services to several game titles within EA across a variety of platforms.

You will ensure the systems are running smoothly, gather requirements, provide feedback, and manage configuration management and development build / test automation infrastructure solutions.

You will report to the Engineering Manager for the DRE Football team.

RESPONSIBILITIES :
• We maintain scripts and software to build games
• We maintain virtualized automation farms, find and address issues
• Monitor metrics to improve automation systems
• Maintain tools, integrations, and technologies to support a reliable release environment
• Report regular status on assigned tasks and identify project risks

Experience REQUIRED :
• 3+ years Software development experience
• Proficiency in a prominent programming language like Python, Java, Groovy, C#, or Powershell

Beneficial Background :
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
• Experience initiating and maintaining Jenkins instances
• Experience writing Jenkinsfiles with Groovy
• Experience with parts of our DevOps tool chain Source Control (Git, Perforce, SVN), Chef, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Nomad, or Consul
• Experience with a non-relational / noSQL database such as Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or DynamoDB
• Experience with art pipelines
• Experience with distributed build systems
• Experience with large-scale, high-availability, high-throughput automation systems
• Knowledge in gaming consoles

About Electronic Arts

Everything we do is designed to inspire the world to play. Through our cutting-edge games, innovative services, and powerful technologies, we bring worlds with infinite possibilities to millions of players and fans around the globe.

We’re looking for collaborative and inclusive people with diverse perspectives who will enrich our culture and challenge us.

We take a holistic approach with our benefits program, focusing on physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support our people through every chapter of life.

We provide comprehensive benefit packages and support for a balanced life with paid time off and new parent leave, plus free games and so much more.

Our goal is to provide a safe and respectful workplace that empowers you to thrive in both work and life.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
Principal Database DevOps Infrastructure Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Position

About Roche Informatics

In Roche Informatics, we build on Roche's 125-year history as one of the world's largest biotech companies, globally recognized for providing transformative innovative solutions across major disease areas. We combine human capabilities with cutting-edge technological innovations to do now what our patients need next. Our commitment to our patients' needs motivates us to deliver technology that evolves the practice of medicine.

Be part of our inclusive team at Roche Informatics, where we're driven by a shared passion for technological novelties and optimal IT solutions.

About the position

As a Principal Database Platform Engineer at Roche, you'll step into a leadership role within our global IT department, championing innovation in an environment characterized by agility, a product-centric approach, and operational efficiency. With a worldwide scope, this position places you at the forefront of shaping, evolving and optimizing our advanced... database platforms, aligning seamlessly with our commitment to efficiency and excellence.

As a specialist in this capacity, you'll spearhead the design, implementation, and optimization of our hybrid database platforms. Serving as the linchpin in our global operations, these platforms are pivotal to our product-oriented initiatives. This role is uniquely compelling as it offers the opportunity to leverage a diverse range of technologies, with a focus on automation, open source solutions, and adherence to lean principles.

You'll partner with cross-functional teams worldwide, engaging closely with Product Managers, Architects, developers, operations specialists, and senior stakeholders in providing innovative solutions to challenges associated with database platform design, evolution and optimization.

Embark on a transformative journey as a Principal Database Reliability Engineer at Roche, where innovation meets reliability. We are in search of an accomplished and visionary leader to drive the evolution of our database systems and ensure unparalleled levels of availability, scalability, and performance.

Job responsibilities
• Drive innovation and establish technical direction to the whole lifecycle of new and existing platforms and services —from inception and design through deployment, operation and retirement by applying strong software engineering principles to build and manage large scale IT infrastructure platforms and services optimizing:
• services reliability, availability, scalability and performance and eliminating work through automation
• software development and deployment by abstracting away the complexity of infrastructure providing self-service tools and APIs for developers that allow code and ship software quickly
• Responsible for continuous improvement activities both in technical, teamwork, collaboration, strategy and processes areas.
• Lead the maintenance of services once they are live by designing metrics to measure and monitor availability, latency and overall system health.
• Proactively plan for IT Infrastructure capacity, performance and scalability to support the evolution of the internal platforms and systems
• Contributes to large initiatives aimed to optimize inter-related platforms for scalability and performance, ensuring that they can handle the increasing demands of applications.
• Lead as consultant the monitoring and resolution of incident/problems with platform operations, setting priorities and ensuring all areas collaborate in the resolution when required.
• Responsible for implementation and keeping updated cost, compliance and security best practices, ensuring that platforms and services meet the corresponding requirements
• Works closely with development teams to ensure that new features and changes are rolled out with reliability in mind bringing a broader and more strategic understanding of reliability that spans multiple facets of development.
• Provide direction and guidance and set up priorities, acting as senior analyst by transforming the customer and developers needs into specific requirements to be implemented by the product team or by other teams.
• Maintain in-depth knowledge of current and emerging technologies within their technical, infrastructure area of responsibility to further the objectives of the team or department and ability to tackle complex and interdisciplinary issues.

Job Requirements
• Very strong and consistent interpersonal skills and proven strong oral and written communication skills.
• Consistently demonstrated customer & delivery focus.
• Proven strong hands-on technical skills in automation, infrastructure as code, logging, monitoring and observability, infrastructure configuration, scripting languages and applications.
• Wide experience working with Infrastructure systems internals, their availability, administration, capacity, configuration, scalability, performance and integrations.
• Wide experience applying Software Engineering principles, automated testing and CI/CD tools to:
• define technical computing infrastructure entirely under the control of software with no operator or human intervention.
• implement and maintain Internal Developers Platforms (IDPs) that enable seamless software development and deployment.
• design, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines enabling developers to easily build, test, and deploy their applications.
• Wide experience applying DepOps, design thinking and lean principles as well as prioritization and agile methodologies to evolve services offered to partners.
• Experience to continuously research, learn, innovate and share knowledge
• Strong ability to work effectively with team members and virtual teams from different locations and different cultural backgrounds.
• Demonstrated exceptional problem-solving and decision-making skills with a focus on anticipating and addressing potential challenges in database platform design and implementation.
• Demonstrated ability to function independently without supervision and navigate ambiguity.

Technology Skills
• Technical Proficiency: Exhibit mastery in Open Source solutions (ie PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS Aurora) and noSQL (ie MongoDB, GraphDB, DocumentDB, Azure CosmosDB) as well as related technologies, showcasing your ability to navigate complexities and solve intricate problems associated with database platform design.
• Proven Leadership: Showcase a distinguished career in leading database platform engineering initiatives. Demonstrate a track record of driving transformative change and setting new benchmarks for excellence.
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and/or GitOps plus required tooling (AWX, Rundeck, Ansible, Jenkins, Puppet, Chef or equivalent).
• Coding and scripting: Python, Perl, Rubby, JS, Go, SQL, GraphQL
• Mastering source code managers (Bitbucket, gitlab, github), CI/CD to automate software distribution
• Cloud native infrastructure: containerization, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Kustomize, Terraform, Pulumi, public cloud cloud-native frameworks.
• Observability, monitoring and security tools such as LogicMonitor, CloudWatch, Open Tracing, and Grafana
• Public Cloud certifications on AWS, Azure and/ or Google Cloud Platform are desired.
• Data mesh and data science experience and knowledge would be considered an asset.
• Public Cloud Solution Architect certifications on AWS, Azure and/ or Google Cloud Platform are desired.

Education / Years of experience
• 11-15 years of relevant work experience
• or 9-12 years with Bachelor’s degree
• or 6-9 years with Masters degree
• At least 8 years experience of working in one or more multinational work environments (e.g. healthcare industry experience is a plus) as a senior systems or software Engineer.

Ability to work across multiple time zones, including on-call and occasionally travel.

Who we are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Spain

Department: Infrastructure **

Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Remote

Reporting To: Nikita Lishin

Description**

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to help us with an outstanding runtime and development platform for Tabby’s services. **

Our tech stack:**

Linux, kubernetes, GCP (GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud PostgreSQL, Spanner), Datadog, Gitlab, Cloudflare, Elasticsearch, Terragrunt, Istio, Vault, ArgoCD, Helm, Go

Key Responsibilities
• Design scalable and reliable cloud infrastructure
• Create a cloud platform suitable for running software services
• Automate infrastructure provisioning
• Ensure the smooth operation of and participate in emergency response situations for outages in our infrastructure
• Security hardening (PCI-DSS)
• Observability and monitoring improvement

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
• 3+ years of experience as DevOps engineer
• Experience with Kubernetes and Service Mesh solutions (istio)
• Familiar... with observability tooling
• Public cloud knowledge, GCP would be a bonus skill
• Experience with investigating issues in production
• Experience with DevOps best practices, including security, CI/CD, monitoring, and alerting
• Basic development skills
• Network knowledge, TCP/IP knowledge, REST API, GRPC

jobs_results.title: Senior Platform Developer/DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Description

Are you an open-minded and stress-tolerant professional interested in working with Infrastructure and multi-clouds? Do you have a Software Engineering background with Python and the ability to quickly learn new technologies? If it sounds like you, this could be the perfect opportunity to join EPAM as a Senior Platform Developer/DevOps Engineer.

Our teams work in highly agile working environments for Fortune 1000 clients, following XP practices and best CI/CD practices. We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with open-minded personality, who can join our friendly environment and become a core contributor to our team of experts.

As a Critical Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer, you will be joining a rapidly evolving department to enable rapid financial service business model changes. We have a huge appetite for change and you will be asked to adapt quickly to take on more responsibility. You will tackle a challenging and varied array of problems in how we gain... further maturity in DevOps tools, processes, and engineering capabilities. You will be an engineer first and foremost, looking for excellent solutions that offer leverage for the company, not just "quick fixes".

Watch the video to learn more about this position:

What You’ll Do

• Provide support for a development team from Ops perspective
• Configure Continuous Integration and Delivery pipelines
• Configure new and already existing environments
• Participate in discussions, influences outcomes, and makes recommendations on feasibility and processes and architecture
• Devise/modify procedures to solve problems considering computer equipment capacity and limitations, operating time, and desired results
• Consult with users and develop business relationships and integrate activities with other IT departments to ensure successful implementation
• Monitor and report to management on the status of project efforts, anticipating/identifying issues that inhibit the attainment of project goals and implementing corrective actions
• Foster and maintain good relationships with customers and IT colleagues to meet expected customer service levels

What You Have

• Demonstrable experience with a leading cloud provider (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform)
• Enterprise-scale software development and release management experience
• Demonstrable experience with one or several facets of infrastructure (Networking, Compute, Security, IAM, Configuration Automation, etc,)
• Expert knowledge Of at least one programming language (Python, C/C++, Scala, Java, Ruby, etc.)
• Strategic thinking complex problem solving and analytical capabilities
• Assess and rapidly resolve business critical issues during assigned on-call shifts
• Able to WFO (1 or 2 days per week)

We Offer

• WORK & LIFE BALANCE. Enjoy more of your personal time with flexible & remote work options, 24 working days of annual leave and paid time off for numerous public holidays
• CONTINUOUS LEARNING CULTURE. Develop your hard & soft skills with internal training and mentorship opportunities, sponsored professional certification, and access to 18,000+ LinkedIn courses
• CLEAR & DIFFERENT CAREER PATHS. Grow in engineering or managerial direction to become a People Manager, in-depth technical specialist, Solution Architect, or Project/Delivery Manager
• GLOBAL RELOCATION OPPORTUNITIES. EPAM has presence in more than 50 countries globally. Explore opportunities to relocate to a new country, and EPAM will provide relocation support for you and your family
• COMPETITIVE BENEFITS. Benefit from a competitive salary, private health insurance, employee stock purchase plan, special discount programs, plus, internal wellbeing programs to take your career to the next level
• STRONG PROFESSIONAL COMMUNITY. Join a global EPAM community of highly skilled experts and connect with them to solve challenges, exchange ideas, share expertise and make friends

About EPAM

• EPAM is a leading digital transformation services and product engineering company with over 53,150 EPAMers in more than 55 countries and regions . Since 1993, our multidisciplinary teams have been helping make the future real for our clients and communities around the world. In 2018, we opened an office in Spain that quickly grew to over 1,450 EPAMers distributed between the offices in Málaga and Madrid as well as remotely across the country . Here you will collaborate with multinational teams, contribute to numerous innovative projects, and have an opportunity to learn and grow continuously

Apply

jobs_results.title: Junior IAM DevOps Developer
jobs_results.description:
OSP (Otto Group Solution Provider) is an IT service provider for retail and logistics with headquarters in Dresden. We live our passion for IT in an appreciative, trusting work environment. What drives us is the idea of working together as a team to achieve great things for our customers.

We rely on the personal responsibility and willingness to learn of our employees, on modern technologies and high quality in software development. Agile working, transparent decisions, a lively feedback culture and collegial cooperation make us successful.

We are active for customers inside and outside the Otto Group. With over 450 employees at several German and international locations, we have been developing flexible software and BI solutions since 1991 and are thus shaping the shopping worlds of tomorrow. We are part of the Otto Group and share a value system that focuses on responsible and sustainable action.

What will you do?
• Our team take care of workplace-related hardware, collaboration... platforms such as M365 and communication services - with state-of-the-art technology that fits perfectly. In particular, we - the Automation Services team - are part of the division responsible for the operation and further development of the Identity and Access Management (IAM).
• Our platform ensures that everyone has all the hardware, software, and access rights needed to be productive in the given moment.
• We ensure the complete and automated User Life Cycle for all colleagues - for joiners, movers and leavers.
• You would be part of a team with 12 highly motivated experts looking forward to work with you and bring you up to speed with our IAM world!

What's your story?
• You have a high customer focus.
• You are highly motivated to ensure our operations quality and service availability (DevOps).
• You have basic knowledge in back and front-end development.
• You have very good knowledge of English speaking and writing.

Nice to have:
- Basic knowledge of SQL, Active Directory, as well as interface programming.
Basic knowledge of One Identity, Azure, AWS, GCP, ….

Contact

Mariel Mantecas
Otto Group Solution Provider Spain S.L.
Calle del Conde de Peñalver 38, 1ª planta | 28006 Madrid
mariel.mantecas(at)ottogroup.com
